reasons: no NHL player-prop prices are captured
no prop market has been tested against closing prices

assumptions: Each player is assumed to dress (each goalie to start): a prop on a player who does not play is void.
The projected lineup is the club's most recent dressed lineup; no injury, scratch or line-rush feed is wired.
Goals are modelled as a thinning of shots on goal, so a player's shot, goal and point probabilities are mutually consistent.

sog.basis: Poisson maximum likelihood on the three seasons before

g.basis: Poisson maximum likelihood on the three seasons before

a.basis: Poisson maximum likelihood on the three seasons before

sa.basis: Poisson maximum likelihood on the three seasons before
